lens: Member evaluator — factual comprehension (simulated AI user lens)
reason: The public proposition is understandable and the mobile capture coherently applies Precision Instrument. Original-resume access is accurately disclosed to applicants. Source-tracing My work through calibration, observation entry, review and submission shows strong standard-form guidance: explicit not observed, weighted readiness, final review and receipt-dependent confirmation. However, the dedicated Group Case journey prevents note-only saving and does not tell members whether saved observations qualify as valid evidence. These materially weaken the focal task despite correct downstream database distinctions. This is independent source/test and supplied-capture assessment, not observed user success or live integration acceptance.

findings.evidence: editNote returns with “Pick a star to save” when countScored is zero; flushNote likewise saves only when countScored > 0. addFlag uses editNote (213-217). Calibration says leave unobserved dimensions blank and record flags. The SQL rate_group_case_applicant permits a nonempty note with zero scores (migration lines 268-270); grading_contract_consistency.sql explicitly verifies note-only evidence remains saved but invalid.
findings.userImpact: A member with a factual observation or flag but insufficient evidence to rate a dimension must leave the note unsaved or invent a rating. Navigating away loses that note.
findings.suggestedFix: Save nonempty notes with null scores, preserve their partial status, and show a confirmed save receipt without requiring a star.

findings.evidence: The member sees “Started grading”, “Saved”, and a dimension count. Neither this roster nor its rubric dialog exposes the active minimum, observed-weight threshold or missing required criteria. GroupCaseRoster lacks minimumObserved/quality fields. In contrast, evaluation_observation_quality in migration 20261016191000 lines 5-33 requires 75% weight, minimum observations and required criteria; the supplied operator capture distinguishes submitted from valid evaluations.
findings.userImpact: Members cannot verify whether their saved work counts toward valid independent evidence, or identify what remains needed before grading closes.
findings.suggestedFix: Return authoritative per-member quality and active rubric requirements; label saved partial versus valid evidence and explain unmet requirements while retaining honest unknown observations.
